proof_classes.P5: parent theorem reconstruction with exact assumptions

rows.title: Sound obligation-derivation composition
rows.statement: If every leaf/axiom in a finite derivation is valid and every rule {ω_i}=>ω is sound (all premises valid => conclusion valid), then the derivation root is valid.
hostiles: unsound single rule contaminates root
infinite/cyclic derivation: induction licence gone (see T70 caveat)

rows.title: Protected reverse-read safety, conditional on coverage
rows.statement: With intended semantics ω*, projection P, reverse-reader set J(y), actual allowed interpretation set A(y) ⊆ J(y): commit only if J(y) nonempty and every ω in J(y) satisfies P(ω)=P(ω*); then every actual interpretation preserves the protected value.
assumptions: gate predicate applied to ALL of J(y)
hostiles: omitted-reading: one actual interpretation missing from J flips negation/scope/referent
empty J(y) commits anyway

rows.title: Protected-semantic preservation composes
rows.statement: For relations R1:A↔B, R2:B↔D with projections P_A,P_B,P_D: if every related (a,b) preserves the protected value and every (b,d) does likewise, then R2∘R1 preserves it.
assumptions: per-relation preservation on full relation domain
hostiles: partial-relation preservation (only some pairs) does not compose

rows.title: Ambiguity-safe action criterion
rows.statement: For possible semantic states S with safe action sets G(s), one deterministic commitment safe for every live interpretation exists iff ∩_{s∈S} G(s) ≠ ∅; else retain ambiguity, acquire discriminating info, abstain, or accept risk.
hostiles: undeclared state in S
G(s) mis-specified

rows.title: Context-free interpretation impossibility
rows.statement: If the same surface form under contexts c1,c2 requires disjoint protected interpretations/actions, no context-free deterministic interpreter can satisfy both; context is mathematically required at that registered scope.

rows.title: Semiring obligation dynamic programming
rows.statement: On finite acyclic deduction hypergraphs, alternatives aggregate by semiring addition and conjunctive premises by multiplication; topological DP exactly computes the registered derivation value. Cyclic/infinite cases require complete/closed-semiring or fixed-point assumptions.
hostiles: acyclic theorem silently reused on cyclic world (SCC)
non-complete semiring fixed point

rows.title: Homomorphic re-evaluation of a shared derivation object
rows.statement: For finite derivation expression E built from semiring +,*, constants, leaf annotations, and semiring homomorphism h:K→K': h(eval_K(E)) = eval_K'(h(E)).
hostiles: h not a homomorphism (breaks one law)
T94: Boolean theorem lift invalid in target semiring

rows.title: Exact positive-provenance revocation
rows.statement: For positive derivation provenance polynomial p∈N[X], revoking evidence variable x_j by substitution x_j:=0 removes exactly the monomials whose support contains x_j; monomials not containing x_j remain unchanged. Alternative supports survive iff at least one surviving monomial remains.
hostiles: missing edge = incomplete dependency capture (planted hostile)
negation laundered into N[X] (T73 boundary)

rows.title: Negation/provenance scope boundary
rows.statement: Positive provenance does not automatically extend to negation; reconstruct Grädel–Tannen dual-indeterminate/quotient approach and register exact laws. No revocation-exactness claim may omit whether negative dependence is represented.
hostiles: negative dependency present but unrepresented

rows.title: Sound problem-reduction composition
rows.statement: A reduction A→B with forward map f_AB and reconstruction g_AB satisfying V_B(f_AB(x),y_B)=1 => V_A(x,g_AB(x,y_B))=1 is sound; sound A→B and B→D compose to a sound A→D.
hostiles: reconstruction implication fails in one leg
solution-coverage gap (verified solution not reconstructible)

rows.title: Stagewise optimization: exact sufficient condition + counterexample
rows.statement: If feasible choices factor as Cartesian product Z=Π_i Z_i and total scalar cost is additively separable C(z)=Σ_i c_i(z_i), independent per-stage minimization gives a global minimum; without factorization/separability greedy stagewise minimization can be arbitrarily bad (witness: interpretation A costs 0 forcing downstream M vs B costs 1 forcing 0; greedy picks M).
hostiles: the embedded greedy-fails witness (M arbitrarily large)
coupled stages

rows.title: Semantic-execution burden decomposition
rows.statement: If complete path cost vector is the coordinatewise sum of integrable stage-cost vectors C_i, then E[Σ_i C_i] = Σ_i E[C_i] coordinatewise; independence unnecessary (linearity of expectation). Does NOT imply T75 separability.
hostiles: double-counted stage (non-disjoint accounting)

rows.title: Abstract-interpretation soundness
rows.statement: Instantiate concrete/abstract domains and Galois connection/adjunction only where the required order/fixpoint structure exists; abstract execution may certify concrete properties when the soundness inequalities hold; abstract states are not automatically true summaries.
hostiles: no Galois connection but claiming abstraction soundness

rows.title: Finite strict-refinement bound
rows.statement: For finite concrete state set of n elements with current partition of k blocks, if every refinement step only splits blocks and strictly increases block count, at most n−k strict refinements occur before the discrete partition.
hostiles: merge step smuggled in (non-monotone block count)
infinite universe

rows.title: Finite CEGAR termination corollary
rows.statement: Under finite concrete universe, terminating checker, and refinement where every spurious counterexample causes a strict partition refinement, CEGAR performs at most n−k refinement rounds before no further strict refinement is possible; deciding the target then depends on checker/property assumptions.
hostiles: non-strict refinement loop (no progress, no termination)
checker non-termination

rows.title: Sound counterexample pruning
rows.statement: If verifier returns a valid counterexample e and every truly satisfying hypothesis must be consistent with e, removing hypotheses inconsistent with e cannot remove any truly satisfying hypothesis.
hostiles: invalid counterexample prunes truth (CEGIS contamination)

rows.title: Version-space elimination telescoping
rows.statement: For finite nested nonempty hypothesis sets H_0⊇…⊇H_m with Δ_i=log(|H_{i-1}|/|H_i|), Σ_i Δ_i = log(|H_0|/|H_m|).
hostiles: calling it Shannon information without probability assumptions
empty intermediate H_i

rows.title: Weakest-precondition / Hoare composition
rows.statement: Pre/postcondition calculi as parents for backward obligation propagation and verified program/problem transformations; OCM residual is typed integration/provenance/resource accounting, not the calculus.

rows.title: Proof-carrying adoption
rows.statement: An untrusted producer may generate arbitrary candidate code/object plus a proof; a small sound checker against a frozen safety policy can authorize acceptance without trusting the producer.
hostiles: checker does not check the policy binding

rows.title: Institution satisfaction invariance
rows.statement: Different logical systems may have different signatures/sentences/models while satisfying the institution satisfaction condition; correct parent for N4/N5 heterogeneous mathematics.

rows.title: Consequence transport through institution comorphisms
rows.statement: For an institution comorphism with sentence translation α and target-model reduct β satisfying M' |=_J α(φ) ⇔ β(M') |=_I φ: source entailment implies translated target entailment for all target models; reflection back to all source models additionally follows when β is model-expansive/surjective.
hostiles: reduct image covering only source models where p true entails translated p without source entailment (model coverage load-bearing)

rows.title: Equality-saturation semantic safety
rows.statement: If every admitted rewrite preserves registered semantics and e-class merges preserve congruence, every expression in an e-class remains semantically equivalent to the seed; extraction of any represented member preserves that semantics.
hostiles: exactly one unsound rewrite contaminates the class
semantic equivalence ≠ equal developmental value (T87)

rows.title: Current semantic equivalence weaker than developmental equivalence
rows.statement: Two proofs/programs/paraphrases may be equivalent now while exposing different reusable lemmas, operators, explanations or future variation neighborhoods; do not quotient for developmental search merely on current checker equality.

rows.title: Protected-semantic rate-distortion
rows.statement: For a prospectively frozen source distribution and protected distortion function, rate-distortion gives minimum asymptotic information rate meeting expected distortion under its assumptions; not a universal token/runtime bound; exact zero-error finite-class lower bounds use HSG-T29/pigeonhole directly.
hostiles: no source law but quoting R(D)

rows.title: Belief-state decision parent
rows.statement: Under POMDP Markov/observation assumptions, the posterior belief state is a sufficient statistic for optimal control; not a theorem that natural-language meaning is a POMDP.

rows.title: Temporal abstraction via options
rows.statement: Under MDP/SMDP assumptions, closed-loop options can enter planning/learning as temporally abstract actions; parent for learned multi-step operators/macros, not proof hierarchy helps at arbitrary tasks.

rows.title: Hierarchy is not a universal speedup
rows.statement: HTN/hierarchical formulations can change complexity dramatically and can be worse/undecidable under some formulations; every decomposition-helps claim needs registered task/representation assumptions and measured lifecycle cost.
hostiles: hierarchy-negative regions must be retained explicitly

rows.title: Discourse/context as state transformation
rows.statement: Language across turns is not repeated stateless sentence parsing; treat context update, referents and commitments as explicit state transformations preserving #93's authority distinction (speaker commitment ≠ world truth).

rows.title: Anytime-valid evidence for an adaptive HPC factory
rows.statement: If a registered confidence sequence has time-uniform coverage under stated assumptions, coverage remains valid at data-dependent stopping times; exploratory adaptive searches remain exploratory; for many confirmatory hypotheses pre-register family/error control or online-FDR/e-values only under dependence assumptions, else freeze a fresh confirmation family after discovery.
assumptions: time-uniform coverage of the registered sequence
hostiles: peeking with a fixed-n interval
adaptive discovery reported as confirmatory

rows.title: Semiring-preservation non-universality
rows.statement: Classical Boolean preservation results do not uniformly lift to arbitrary semiring semantics; broad positives for lattice semirings, failures for several others. Changing the semiring while keeping every theorem is explicitly forbidden.
hostiles: Boolean-to-arbitrary-semiring lift attempted
